@title PokeBattleToken (POKE ERC-20 Currency + 1vCPU Battle Escrow)
 @notice MG3012 Blockchain Technology for Business - Final Project
@notice 1. Faucet: Gives any new player wallet 100 POKE coins so they can play immediately
@notice 2. Locks 50 POKE coins from the player's wallet into the contract escrow
@notice 4. Single RPC call to load all HUD balances

claimStarterCoins().notice: 1. Faucet: Gives any new player wallet 100 POKE coins so they can play immediately

getGameState(address).notice: 4. Single RPC call to load all HUD balances

lockCoinsAndStart().notice: 2. Locks 50 POKE coins from the player's wallet into the contract escrow

settleBattle(bool).notice: 3. Triggered automatically when HP hits 0:         - Player Wins -> Contract sends 100 POKE to Player         - Computer Wins -> Contract sends the locked 50 POKE to your computerHouseWallet
